summary.text: Erica Neely is the Republican candidate for the Nevada State Assembly, District 9, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a wife, mother, foster and adoptive parent, small business owner, homeschool leader, youth soccer coach and author who has lived in Nevada for more than 20 years.

paragraphs.text: Erica Neely was born in Los Angeles, California.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she grew up in South Central Los Angeles as the daughter of immigrants from Mexico and El Salvador, with Spanish as her first language.
She said she met her husband, bought a home and built a business in Nevada, and that her faith led her to foster children and adopt a daughter.
Neely advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
She listed her key messages as better schools and more educational opportunities, safe neighborhoods and strong public safety, and lower costs and more affordable housing.
She said she is passionate about supporting small businesses and skilled trades and protecting parents' rights, and she listed an endorsement from Governor Joe Lombardo.
